title: Reconstruction / Redevelopment of Cluster(s) of Buildings under Urban Renewal Cluster Development Scheme (CDS)
scope: Cluster redevelopment (URS/CDS) — mixes cessed buildings, MHADA acquired buildings, tenanted/authorized buildings 30 yr+, Govt/MCGM/MHADA lands & buildings, dilapidated buildings, and slum pockets (up to 50% of cluster area) into ONE scheme.

cluster_definition.boundary_defined_by: Existing distinguishing physical boundaries (roads, nallas, railway lines) — else Municipal Commissioner decides
cluster_definition.single_plot_treatment: Land under CDS treated as ONE plot for FSI + marginal distances, regardless of underlying tenures. No separate amalgamation approval required.

eligible_building_categories: Cessed buildings in Island City (attracting MHAD Act 1976)
Buildings acquired by MHADA under MHAD Act 1976 (30 yr+)
Central Govt / State Govt / Semi-Govt / MCGM / MHADA institutional / office / tenanted buildings 30 yr+
Vacant / built-upon land of State Govt / Semi-Govt / MCGM / MHADA within cluster area (with dept consent)
Buildings unfit for human habitation certified by MHADA/MCGM/MBRRB
Slum areas declared under Slum Act Sec 4 OR pre-1/1/2000 slums (max 50% of cluster area)

eligibility.existence_evidence: Certified MCGM 1995-96 inspection extract OR Court Order proving pre-13/6/96 existence

list_certification.slum_areas: Competent Authority under Slum Act Ch I-E

consent_requirement.exception: No consent needed if MHADA/MCGM undertakes on own land directly (no developer)

rehab_area_entitlement.additional_area_cap_condition: If existing carpet ≥ 100 sqm, additional area computed on capped 100 sqm basis
rehab_area_entitlement.additional_area_applicability_condition: Only when scheme has max FSI of 4.00

total_fsi_permissible.computed_on: gross plot area excluding reservations/road setback/existing muni roads BUT including BUA under reservation/road setback

incentive_fsi_table_B_by_basic_ratio_and.basic_ratio_formula: LR / RC (both per ASR of year of LOI approval; weighted avg if multiple)
incentive_fsi_table_B_by_basic_ratio_and.ratio_locked: Fixed at LOI approval — does NOT change even if scheme is later revised

balance_fsi_sharing_table_C.description: If rehab + incentive < 4.00, balance shared as BUA between MHADA and Developer/Promoter

land_pooling_methods: Land of Public Authority: via Empowered Committee (chaired by Chief Secretary) — GoM decides terms
Exchange for equivalent-value land per ASR
Transfer to legal entity (Society/Company/Trust) proportional to stake
Acquisition (if promoter has ≥ 70% + dangerous buildings on balance) — via HPC recommendation to Govt

impact_assessment_required.trigger: Before Municipal Commissioner identifies cluster for CDS
impact_assessment_required.scope: Impact on city + sector-level infrastructure + amenities + traffic + environment

augmentation_rules.no_augmentation_after: CC issued for > 75% of total permissible BUA of original scheme
augmentation_rules.deletion_allowed_conditions: Rehab construction not commenced AND contiguity not broken

extraction_gaps.note: Reg 33(9)(A) — Dharavi Notified Area (DNA) and Reg 33(9)(B) — BDD chawls at Naigaon are distinct sub-clauses with their own terms; extract separately when needed.
